profiles.label: Féminine · Petite enfance · environ 5 ans
profiles.instruction: A fictional female voice of a young child, around five years old, with light natural articulation. Speak French naturally, with clear pronunciation, a calm friendly tone, and normal conversational pace. Dry close-microphone recording, no music, no background noise. Avoid caricature or exaggerated pitch.
